
## 調參邏輯
There are several approaches to fine-tuning language models using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). The commonly used method is PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization), while a recent research paper from DeepSeek introduced GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization).[1]
